exam.title: AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer - Associate (beta)
exam.study_prerequisites: No formal prerequisite; AWS targets candidates with at least one year using SageMaker AI, Amazon Bedrock and related ML engineering services, at least one year in a related engineering/data role, and experience with both traditional ML and generative AI. Practice governed data/features/chunks/embeddings, models/FMs/RAG/evaluation, MLOps/LLMOps, knowledge bases, agents/tools/state, monitoring/cost and layered security.

objective_coverage.objective_group: Data Preparation for ML and AI
ML Model and Foundation Model Development
Deployment and Orchestration of ML and AI Workflows
Operating, Monitoring, and Securing ML and AI Solutions

review.notes: The initial September 1 MLA-C02 beta guide was reconciled with all four detailed domain pages, exact C01 comparison, live credential page, announcement and current service/training references. It covers every added vector/multimodal/embedding/RAG/FM/evaluation/agent/LLMOps/observability/cost/security skill without dropping retained traditional ML and MLOps. Three scenarios, eight labs and 42 original checks map data/features/chunks/embeddings/vectors; model/FM selection and customization; retrieval/generation/human/judge evaluation; models/knowledge/prompts/agents/tools/state/pipelines; and layered monitoring, unit economics and security. The ME1-C02 beta code, September 29 delivery, 170-minute/85-question/USD-75 contract, result timing and early-2027 GA plan are explicit. All 16 URLs are cataloged: 15 reachable and the O'Reilly C01 foundation book automation-blocked; none missing or broken. The launch-day commercial catalog gap and Tutorials Dojo C01 internals are labeled, and no recalled questions are used.

findings.recommendation: Teach permission inheritance,12-hour/session bound,refresh/revocation and long-term distinction.
findings.resolution: Teach permission inheritance,12-hour/session bound,refresh/revocation and long-term distinction.

findings.title: CodeCommit onboarding uncertainty can be resolved
findings.evidence: Official history records reopeningNovember25,2025 afterJuly2024 closure.
findings.recommendation: Replace outdated uncertainty with dated reopening and region/integration checks.
findings.resolution: Replace outdated uncertainty with dated reopening and region/integration checks.

findings.title: Old agent and SageMaker labs may not be available in new accounts

findings.resolution: Add account-access checks and bounded implementation alternatives.

findings.title: Compression must preserve evidence and earn its total cost
